title: Retaking Thirsk
description: Help Bujold the Unworthy and her exiled warriors retake Thirsk Mead Hall from the rieklings, then accompany her to Hrothmund's Barrow where she seeks the founder's blessing to continue her leadership.

base_facts: I lead the exiled Nords of Thirsk Mead Hall, driven out by rieklings.
We lost our home because we grew soft on mead and comfort.
I need someone to help rouse my warriors and retake Thirsk.

RETAKE_THIRSK: We have retaken Thirsk from the rieklings.
COMMUNE_WITH_SPIRIT: Hrothmund's spirit denied me his blessing, saying my softness led to our exile and no one among us is fit to lead.
BUJOLD_CONFRONTATION: I will lead Thirsk regardless of Hrothmund's judgment. I asked the outsider to keep my secret and not tell the others what happened here.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If my secret is kept, I continue leading Thirsk and begin a new tradition focused on the present instead of the old ways of Hrothmund.
If the outsider opposes my deception, I will attack them rather than surrender my leadership.
If my secret is betrayed to Kuvar, I am cast out of Thirsk and disappear from the hall forever.

base_facts: I am a warrior of Thirsk, exiled by the rieklings who overran our hall.
I am frustrated with Bujold's hesitation and want to retake our home.

RETAKE_THIRSK: We have retaken Thirsk. The rieklings are dead.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If told the truth about Hrothmund's denial, I confront Bujold and she is cast out of Thirsk for her deceit.
If the outsider keeps Bujold's secret, I remain unaware that Hrothmund rejected her and continue following her leadership.
With Bujold removed, I become the de facto authority at Thirsk Mead Hall and offer heavy armor training as a reward.

beats.comment: Player discovers the exiled Nords at Bujold's Retreat and learns about their situation.
Player agrees to help retake Thirsk, triggering the assault on the mead hall.
Rieklings are defeated and Thirsk is retaken. Bujold asks the player to be her second at Hrothmund's Barrow.
Player agrees to accompany Bujold to Hrothmund's Barrow for the blessing ritual.
Player witnesses Hrothmund's spirit deny Bujold's blessing, declaring no one among them fit to lead.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player witnesses Hrothmund's spirit deny Bujold's blessing, declaring no one among them fit to lead.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player witnesses Hrothmund's spirit deny Bujold's blessing, declaring no one among them fit to lead.

beats.comment: Bujold reveals she will lead anyway and asks player to keep her secret. If opposed, she attacks.
Quest ends either by keeping Bujold's secret, killing her, or betraying her to Kuvar.
